photography.scene: 首尔街头冷灰立面，建筑线条清楚且环境干扰少。
photography.lighting: 侧上方大面积柔光，窄而柔的阴影强化已有结构；中低对比，稍压高光。
photography.composition: 杂志式清晰布局，依靠已有轮廓与建筑线条的秩序，不拉长身体或衣长。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 背景为黑白灰及冷米色的低饱和关系。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

persona: calm composed confidence, understated cool attitude, editorial stillness
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。calm composed confidence, understated cool attitude, editorial stillness

commitments.show: large soft cool-gray light from the upper side; narrow soft shadows, mid-low contrast, highlights held down
commitments.check: soft shadows fall narrow under structure; colour cool-neutral; no warm golden light

commitments.show: clean cool-gray city architecture: concrete or stone facades, glass, a minimal lobby; few objects and no clutter
commitments.check: clear architectural lines behind; no street clutter, no shop signs, no plants dominating

commitments.show: an ordered editorial frame aligned to vertical and horizontal architectural lines, the figure placed with clear negative space
commitments.check: verticals stay vertical; the figure sits against a clean line or plane with open space

commitments.show: still, composed expression with closed lips; cool and calm, no smile
commitments.check: neutral closed mouth; calm face; no smile, no aegyo, no frown

commitments.show: clean grooming: smooth even skin, natural brows, no visible colour makeup; hair as the identity reference, neat and smooth
commitments.check: skin even without shine; no visible eye or lip colour; hair tidy

action_tendency: Still and architectural: upright verticals, minimal gestures, weight even or on one leg, pauses rather than movement; never loose, slouched, playful or idol-like.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing upright and still in front of a clean gray facade, weight even, shoulders level
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms straight and relaxed at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: vertical posture centred on a clean plane; not touching the wall

pose_vocabulary.body: standing side-on beside a glass facade, body in profile, face turned toward camera
pose_vocabulary.check: clear profile line of the body; glass behind with no distracting reflections

pose_vocabulary.body: seated upright on a low cube bench in a minimal lobby, knees at hip width, feet flat, back straight
pose_vocabulary.hands: both hands resting on the bench edge beside the hips
pose_vocabulary.check: upright and still; hands beside the hips, not on the garment; garment front fully visible

pose_vocabulary.body: slow straight walk parallel to a long facade, body side-on to camera, measured step
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms nearly still at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: measured step, arms quiet; the facade line runs straight behind

pose_vocabulary.body: standing still under a plain awning at a clean wet street corner, body three-quarter, weight on one leg
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms straight and relaxed at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: still posture; arms at the sides; nothing in front of the garment

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a square concrete column, body turned three-quarter, one shoulder close to but not touching the column
pose_vocabulary.check: column edge as a strong vertical beside the figure; no lean

pose_vocabulary.body: standing still with the back to camera facing a clean gray facade, weight even
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms straight and relaxed at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: back of the garment fully readable; symmetric and still

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, shoulders square, chin level, completely still
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms straight at the sides, below the frame
pose_vocabulary.check: no hand touches the garment; collar, closure and shoulder line readable
